PAPERS PACKAGING VISUAL COMMUNICATION In Europe, Canada and Latin America, Antalis is the leading B2B distributor of products and services in Papers and industrial Packaging, and number two in the distribution of Visual Communication media. Headquartered in the Paris area (France), Antalis operates in 34 countries serving over 100,000 customers with a team of 4,300 employees and breakthrough e-commerce solutions. Our 120 distribution centres, focused on eco-responsibility, provide world-class services. Our vision is to strengthen Antalis as the leading and most trusted international business-to-business distributor of papers, packaging, Visual Communication, supplies and equipment and associated services. Our mission is to deliver excellence for our customers through expertise and innovation in the products and services that we provide and in our relationships with our business partners and stakeholders. We are socially responsible and agile in broadening our business portfolio, accelerating our digital transformation, developing our teams and achieving strong returns on capital employed. The Braden Promise™ WE BELIEVE IN MAKING ORDERING YOUR SUPPLIES EASIER. “Braden Supply is a nationwide distributor of packaging, shipping, and janitorial supplies. Since 1995 we’ve made business easier by bringing new ideas in supplies to our customers.” Delivering from our Utica location in Central New York, we also have a Chicago warehouse that ships Next Day UPS and UPS Ground. Between our fast delivery, responsiveness, and huge product selection, we’re in tune with your company’s needs. We invite you to call us today. You’ll improve your cash flow with our large volume pricing and no minimum order. We also customize purchase orders to your company’s needs. Additionally, consignment and delayed billing options are available to qualified customers. Third-generation central New Yorker Steve Sweet started Braden in 1995 after another business he owned encountered a critical situation: someone forgot to order the tape to seal the shipping boxes. It was late in the day, and the customer needed the product the next day. Production supervisors and office management scoured the vicinity, buying the entire tape stock at every hardware store in the area. When they returned, employees manually applied the tape, instead of the automated systems in place. This oversight cost the company thousands of dollars and created an inconsistent packaging image, which violated the company’s quality control standards, although Sweet kept his company’s commitment to an on-time delivery. Drawing from this lesson and vowing to never let a supply disaster happen again, Steve Sweet founded Braden Supply Co. to ensure that other local companies would always have items such as boxes, tape, pallet wrap, shrink film and poly bags in stock. Road Freight Over-the-Road transport is a widely used shipping method. Trucks can reach areas that may not be accessible by rail or sea. Ocean Freight Ocean freight is essential for global supply chains, providing a cost-effective solution for the transportation of goods across the world’s oceans. About Us We Provide Fast & Safe Service to Our Customers About Mission Goal Complete Packaging Systems Inc. is an industry leader in the development and supply of products designed to secure your product, and prevent transit damage during rail, intermodal and OTR shipping. In addition to the supply of dunnage materials for cargo securement, CPS uses a consultative approach for damage prevention with training and implementation of best practices for load standards required by industry regulators. Some of our offerings include Cyclone airbags, AAR-approved rubber friction mats, Tex-Steel synthetic cord strapping, and honeycomb and corrugated dunnage items. Mehr als nur Standard im E-Commerce 08.06.2026 Wellpappfaltkartons sind der unterschätzte Allrounder im Online-Handel. Vielfalt, Service, Mehrwert sind unsere Leistungsversprechen. Mit einem beispiellos großen Sortiment, eigener Logistik, engagierten Kundenberater*innen und effizienten digitalen Lösungen schaffen wir wirkungsvolle Supply-Chain-Konzepte für unsere Kunden. Dabei leben wir eine enge professionelle Partnerschaft und sind stolz auf unsere über 50.000 Kunden und langjährigen Lieferantenbeziehungen. Über uns Persönlich und nah – in jeder Region vor Ort Kurze Wege, schlanke Prozesse und der direkte Draht von Mensch zu Mensch prägen unsere Kundenbeziehungen. Denn durch unsere regionale Struktur sind wir nicht nur mit unserer Logistik schnell bei Ihnen, sondern auch in Ihrer Region als mittelständischer Großhändler verwurzelt und verbunden. Auch wenn vieles heute digital funktioniert, steht für uns die persönliche Nähe nach wie vor im Vordergrund.

A nossa liderança assenta em 50 anos de experiência, uma rede logística e um compromisso inabalável com a sustentabilidade e a inovação em todas as áreas de negócio. Como posso entrar em contacto direto com as vossas equipas? Pode contactar-nos através dos nossos centros operacionais no Grande Porto ( 229 410 187 ) e Grande Lisboa ( 219 239 544 ), ou via Whatsapp através do número 914 834 631 , para uma resposta imediata. A Inapa opera apenas no mercado português? A Inapa opera em todo o território Nacional, incluindo ilhas, o que nos permite garantir a proximidade e uma capacidade de distribuição em tempo útil aos nossos parceiros. Como é que a Inapa gera valor real para os seus acionistas e parceiros? Geramos valor através de uma gestão rigorosa e responsável, focada no crescimento consistente do portefólio e no estabelecimento de relações de confiança de longo prazo. Onde posso consultar a vossa Política de Privacidade e RGPD? A nossa política está disponível para consulta no rodapé de todas as páginas do website, garantindo total transparência e segurança no tratamento dos seus dados. Como posso solicitar uma proposta personalizada para o meu negócio? Basta preencher o formulário de contacto nesta página ou nas áreas de negócio específicas, indicando as suas necessidades técnicas e volumes previstos. Que tipo de suportes encontro na área de Graphic Solutions? Disponibilizamos a mais ampla gama de papéis criativos, suportes técnicos e materiais inovadores, desenhados para elevar a qualidade de qualquer projeto de comunicação visual. A Inapa oferece suporte técnico na escolha de materiais gráficos? Sim, a nossa consultoria técnica ajuda os clientes a selecionar o material e a tecnologia mais adequados, garantindo que a comunicação da marca se diferencia no mercado. Como é garantida a origem sustentável dos nossos papéis? Grande parte dos nossos produtos gráficos provêm de florestas geridas de forma responsável, apoiados pelas rigorosas certificações internacionais FSC®C217333, e PEFC/13-31-375. É possível solicitar amostras de papel antes de avançar com uma encomenda? Sim, incentivamos os nossos parceiros a testar a textura e performance dos nossos materiais para assegurar que o resultado final cumpre as expectativas do projeto sempre que o fornecedor tenha essa disponibilidade. Quais as principais marcas representadas na área Graphic? Trabalhamos com os principais fabricantes mundiais, garantindo uma oferta sólida de marcas líderes que são sinónimo de excelência e inovação na indústria. As soluções de Graphic incluem materiais para impressão digital de grande formato? Sim, o nosso portefólio evolui constantemente para acompanhar as novas tecnologias, incluindo suportes de alta performance para os sistemas de impressão mais avançados. O que distingue a oferta da Inapa no segmento Office Visuals? Distinguimo-nos por um portefólio abrangente de elevada qualidade, que combina consumíveis essenciais com um serviço logístico eficiente e profundo conhecimento de mercado. Dispomos também de uma gama abrangente de substratos para a área de impressão de grande formato CAD e VISCOM. Como é que a Inapa assegura a continuidade operacional do meu escritório? About PackagingSupplies.com, a Discount Shipping Supplies Company PackagingSupplies.com is a division of Cleveland Packaging, Inc., a supplier of packaging and shipping supplies serving businesses of various industries. In 1998 the corporation expanded the product line and launched our online national division PackagingSupplies.com to better serve the entire country through distribution centers located in Chicago, Cleveland, Dallas, Greenville (SC), Los Angeles, and New York. PackagingSupplies.com became one of the very first online catalogs in the entire industry and continues to be one of the most popular destinations to purchase such supplies. We are committed to bringing our customers 100% satisfaction with quality products, excellent pricing, and packaging expertise to make your job easier. We offer an extensive selection of over 17,000 popular and hard-to-find packaging supplies which are all ready to ship. At any given time, 98% of the items displayed on this website ship the same day when orders are placed before 1:00pm EST. Our newly expanded customer service and sales offices, located in Cleveland, Ohio has put ten years of packaging supply distribution experience into designing the industry's premier online catalog. In doing so, it was our intent to offer small, medium, and large businesses an online catalog that is convenient and easy to use, based on customer needs. Afterall, our customers have come to us with various goals in mind. Some want to decrease their product damages, some want to increase productivity, some wish to decrease costs, and some want a more professional image displayed in their product's packaging. Whatever your goal, PackagingSupplies.com can help you meet it. To all of our current customers, we truly value your business and look forward to continuing our relationship with you. If this is your first experience with PackagingSupplies.com, please give us a try. We would like to show you how quality products, excellent service and pricing can make a difference. Our pricing is guaranteed. If you find a lower price elsewhere on the exact same item, we will meet or beat that price as long as it does not reflect a competitor's free offer, rebate, bonus, one-of-a-kind, or other limited guarantee offer. If you don't see the item you are looking for, please contact us. There are hundreds and hundreds of items that we sell that are not listed on our online catalog yet. If by chance we don't have the item you are looking for, we will be happy to give you names of companies who can help you. Visit our contact us page for more information. We strive to be the one-stop source for your packaging needs and our goal, once again, is 100% customer satisfaction. Thank you for visiting! Post-consumer waste has completed its life cycle as a consumer item and can now be recycled and reused. With less plastic used per unit, Polylite lowers your carbon footprint and is PAS2050. Made without any genetically modified organisms (GMOs), they are both environmentally friendly and highly effective. Available in various formats, including loose, boxed, or perforated rolls. Brands we've worked with Helpful Insights How to choose the right pharmaceutical packaging for different drug formats Pharmaceutical packaging plays a critical role in protecting medicines from damage, contamination, and environmental factors throughout their shelf life. But there is no one-size-fits-all approach. The right packaging solution needs to be carefully matched to the drug format, formulation, and intended use to maintain product safety, stability, compliance, and usability. Read the article 7 ways to reduce handling damage with improved protective packaging Handling damage is one of the most common causes of product loss throughout warehousing, distribution, and fulfilment operations. From drops and impacts during transit to crushing, vibration, and repeated manual handling, products can be exposed to a wide range of risks before they reach the end customer. These incidents can lead to costly replacements, delays, customer dissatisfaction, and unnecessary waste. Read the article From foam to void fill: How protective packaging solutions work in real operations Protective packaging is often viewed in terms of the materials themselves: foam, bubble wrap, void fill, or edge protection. But successful packaging is about far more than what goes into the box. In real warehouse and distribution environments, protective packaging must perform consistently under the pressures of fast-paced packing operations, multiple handling points, and increasingly complex supply chains. Forty years later, we have expanded to include four distribution locations across Canada, including a fully equipped manufacturing facility in Winnipeg. We offer both local and offshore production options, supported by our strong network of partners throughout the U.S. and Canada. This flexibility allows us to provide solutions that help our customers optimize both budget and lead time. Whether you have special loading requirements, an oddly shaped or sized item, or restrictions due to export regulations concerning packaging type, size, material, or weight, our extensive experience enables us to find custom packaging solutions for even the most complex and unique challenges. We provide custom-printed pouches and bags tailored to your specific product needs, packaging budget, print minimums, and tight timelines. At this stage, the Approvers functionality is not available on Back to School orders, but we are working on introducing this. Why is my order split and supplied across multiple deliveries? In order to provide our extensive range, sometimes a product is not located in your local warehouse and it will be shipped from an alternative location. Sometimes products will be out of stock and sent in separate deliveries when they become available. Why are some of my ordered items on back order? Your items are on back order because we don't have enough stock on hand to fulfil your order. We will notify you of any back ordered items on your Sales Order Confirmation which is sent out to you via your Order Confirmation email. How do I check which items I have on back order? To view back orders, log into your relevant account, go to the My Account icon and select Backorders . I have not received all the goods on my order, what do I do? There may be times where your items may come in separate deliveries. You can check the status of your remaining items on our Track Orders page. For all orders other than Back to School orders, if you have received your order and invoiced items are missing, you may initiate a return within 14 days of the delivery date free of charge for full credit, refund or replacement. Apropos Alltag: Das aktuelle Thema Nachhaltigkeit ist bei uns schon Routine. So legen wir Wert auf recyclingfähige Materialien, setzen auf die Nutzung innovativer Werkstoffe und bieten Produkte auch in wiederverwendbaren Alternativen an. Doch auch zu den kleinen und mittelständischen Betrieben haben wir immer noch engen Kontakt. Unseren Entwicklerdrang der Anfangsjahre haben wir ebenfalls beibehalten. Deshalb verbessern und erweitern wir ständig unser Produktspektrum. 1977 … … starteten wir mit der Produktion von Einweg-Sitzschonern und Papierfußmatten für Autowerkstätten. Der enge Kontakt zu unseren Kunden machte uns aber schnell klar: Der Bedarf nach hochwertigen Werkstatt-Lösungen war viel größer. Ehlken Verpackungen GmbH - Ihr Profi für Verpackungen in Deutschland Home Produkte Lachsbretter Goldtrays Papiersorten Kunststoffschalen Kunststoffeimer Aktuelles Kontakt Impressum Datenschutz +49 4741 6031874 Home Produkte Lachsbretter Goldtrays Papiersorten Kunststoffschalen Kunststoffeimer Aktuelles Kontakt Impressum Datenschutz Verpackungen Verpackungen Verpackungen Ehlken Verpackungen GmbH – Hochwertige Lebensmittelverpackungen aus Deutschland Ob Feinkostschale, Kunststoffeimer oder Karton, wir haben die passende Verpackung für Ihr Produkt. Die Ehlken Verpackungen GmbH beliefert Food- und Non-Food-Abnehmer aus dem Kleingewerbe und Großhandel mit hochwertigen Verpackungsmaterialien – deutschlandweit und im Großteil der EU. Produkte Entdecken Sie hochwertige Verpackungslösungen für Food- und Non-Food-Produkte – zuverlässig, vielseitig, deutschlandweit verfügbar. weiter Lachsbretter Stilvolle Lachsbretter für Präsentation und Verkauf – funktional, hochwertig verarbeitet und perfekt für Feinkost. weiter Goldtrays Edle Goldtrays für ansprechende Warenpräsentation – ideal für Lebensmittel, Geschenke und Premiumprodukte. weiter Papiersorten Entdecken Sie vielseitige Papiersorten für Verpackungen im Food- und Non-Food-Bereich – funktional, nachhaltig und optimal für unterschiedlichste Anwendungen. weiter Kunststoffschalen Robuste Kunststoffschalen für sichere und hygienische Verpackungen – ideal für Lebensmittel, Industrieprodukte und vielseitige Einsatzbereiche. weiter Kunststoffeimer Stabile Kunststoffeimer für Transport und Lagerung – zuverlässig, dicht und individuell anpassbar für Food- und Non-Food-Anwendungen. weiter Vom Einzelunternehmen zum Verpackungsprofi 1953 vom Kaufmann Karl-Heinz Ehlken gegründet, bestand das Firmenareal am Fischereihafen Bremerhaven zunächst nur aus einem Büro und einem kleinen Lagerraum. Unser Warensortiment beschränkte sich auf Körbe, Salz und Papier für die Bremerhavener Fischindustrie. Im Laufe der Zeit wurde es jedoch kontinuierlich erweitert. Das stetig wachsende Angebot erforderte die Anmietung weiterer Lagerhallen an den unterschiedlichsten Standorten im Fischereihafen, die schließlich in einem modernen Großlager zusammengeführt wurden. Breite Produktpalette für die verschiedensten Anwendungen Wir versorgen Kleinabnehmer und Großhändler mit erstklassigen Verpackungsmaterialien in den unterschiedlichsten Varianten. Von Feinkostbechern und Feinkostschalen über Kunststoffbehälter, Siegelrandbeutel und Kartons bis hin zu Papierverpackungen liefern wir erstklassige Qualitätsprodukte. Die meisten Materialien können auch bedruckt werden, um einen höheren Wiedererkennungswert zu betonen. Als Abnehmer werden Sie professionell und kompetent in allen material- und anwenderbezogenen Fragen beraten und wir finden für Sie die Verpackung, die Ihrem Bedarf am besten entspricht. Jahrzehntelanges Know-how und hervorragende Lieferanten Ehlken Verpackungen GmbH verfügt somit über jahrzehntelange Erfahrung im Handel mit Verpackungsmaterialien. Durch unsere hervorragenden Lieferantenkontakte und unseren bedarfsorientierten, flexiblen Service sind wir in der Lage, Sie mit den besten Produkten zu beliefern. Für Eilaufträge stehen uns eigene Transportfahrzeuge zur Verfügung. Wir sind in ganz Deutschland, aber auch in vielen anderen EU-Ländern tätig und legen größten Wert auf exzellenten Service und größtmögliche Kundenzufriedenheit. Gerne nehmen wir uns die Zeit für Ihr Anliegen. Haben Sie Fragen? After a successful career as a salesman for companies like Suncoast / Berry, Continental Plastics / Silgan, and Tri-Delta / Pretium, Hank was encouraged to start his own company. Twenty-Five years later, All American continues to fill the needs of their customers by providing an extensive range of quality packaging components, with on-time deliveries and competitive pricing. In recent years Hank has mentored his son Henry who has taken over many of his responsibilities, and added a number of seasoned sales reps throughout the Northeast and Canada. While some of our current customers have been with us since our inception, we will always welcome new customers to join our “Family” business, who are looking to reduce costs and improve their packaging. From a small office in Pasadena, the company grew into a trusted national packaging solutions provider. For more than four decades, Norm and Candace Frank carried that vision forward, leading with a commitment to service, innovation, and lasting partnerships. Today, under the leadership of third-generation CEO Brandon Frank , we proudly honor our legacy while driving the future of sustainable, high-performance packaging. Our Commitment Quality First We maintain a network of trusted domestic manufacturers to ensure the highest quality components. Customer-Centric Approach Our team goes beyond simply supplying packaging—we partner with clients to find innovative solutions. Adaptability From custom mold fabrication to stock packaging, we're equipped to meet diverse and unique customer needs. OUR PROMISE As a privately owned company with nearly 50 years of experience, we pride ourselves on being lean, responsive, and always ready to help our clients achieve packaging success. Whether you need a unique custom solution or a streamlined standard approach, Pacific Packaging Components is your trusted partner. FAQs What makes PPC different? We’re not a manufacturer. We’re not a broker. And we’re definitely not here to ghost you once your PO is in. We’re your packaging partner — which means: No markups or hidden service fees Factory-direct pricing when needed A full team: sourcing, project management, engineering, logistics Support from spec to shelf (color matching, QC, sustainability audits — all included) You get our team, our expertise, and our full attention. No extra charge. Who do you typically work with? Most of our clients have established DTC or retail presence, minimum order volumes of 10,000 units, and invest $100K+ annually in packaging. If packaging is starting to feel like a full-time job, that’s when we step in. Can you help with both custom and stock packaging? Absolutely. We’ll help you weigh what makes the most sense for your needs — whether that’s a speed-to-market solution or a custom mold with a six-month runway. Either way, we’ll make sure it performs, feels premium, and tells your brand story. What’s your minimum order quantity? Our standard MOQ is 10,000 units per component — but some formats and materials vary. If you’re close or unsure, just reach out. We’ll talk through what’s realistic and what options we can offer. Do you offer sustainable and refillable options? It’s kind of our thing. We source mono-material pumps, refillable formats, glass, aluminum, PCR, and more. We’ll break down what’s actually sustainable (and what’s just marketing) and help you choose packaging that aligns with your values and your operational needs. How fast can you turn something around? Lead times depend on the scope and material. Stock options move fast. Custom projects vary — but we’ll map it out clearly from the start, build in buffer where needed, and keep things moving. We’ve pulled off miracles before, but we prefer to plan like professionals. TRUSTED BY ICONIC BRANDS Stay Ahead in Packaging Smart packaging isn’t just what we make—it’s what we share.
